name: hotdata-memory
description: Stores Claude Code's auto memory as rows in Hotdata via hotmemory, and loads it back at session start.

store.title: Store
store.description: Where memory records live. 'local' keeps a JSON file; 'hotdata' keeps rows in a managed database.

database_name.title: Database name
database_name.description: Name of the Hotdata managed database to open or create, when store is 'hotdata'.

database_id.title: Database id
database_id.description: Open this database id instead of looking the name up. Optional.

embedder.title: Embedder
embedder.description: 'hashed' is built in: no key, no network, matches words. 'openai' needs OPENAI_API_KEY and matches meaning.

scope_prefix.title: Scope prefix
scope_prefix.description: First label of the namespace. Records go under <prefix>/<project>.

budget.title: Context budget
budget.description: Characters of memory to load at session start.

workspace_id.title: Workspace id
workspace_id.description: Hotdata workspace that holds the memory database. Defaults to the first workspace of the login.

api_key.title: Hotdata API key
api_key.description: Leave empty to use HOTDATA_API_KEY or the key that `hotdata auth login` saved.

api_url.title: API URL
api_url.description: Hotdata API base URL. Leave empty for the default.

memory_root.title: Memory root
memory_root.description: Directory under which a written .md file counts as a memory note. Defaults to ~/.claude/projects.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: 'mirror' follows Claude's memory files. 'standalone' makes the store the only memory: Claude records with the memory command and writes no files.
